title: SSTO fusion powered spaceplane using compact CHARM fusion reactor and 3-cycle electric rocket engine
description: Vehicle-integration paper for a single-stage-to-orbit spaceplane powered by a continuous CHARM proton–boron-11 plant with direct energy conversion: Shuttle-class cargo bay, municipal-runway ops to ISS-altitude LEO, free/scarce air then tanked water propulsion, mass–energy budget, station layout, and imputed CHARM/engine flight specs versus present design gaps. The reactor and combined-cycle engine are detailed in full in two companion papers (see related_identifiers). Readable PDF: zenodo.pdf. Source: https://github.com/catskillsresearch/charm_p11b_ssto
notes: Primary readable artifact is zenodo.pdf. Markdown source is arxiv.md. AI layout figures are documented by prompt artifacts under research/figures/prompts/. Prepared with LLM assistance; verify before scientific or policy use. Part of a three-paper series with the companion reactor paper (charm_compact_p11b) and companion engine paper (electric_3_stage_ssto_engine).
